paragraphs.text: Tarpan is an obsolete creature type for a species of horse that inhabited colder climates on Dominaria .

Tarpan originally debuted as a type in Ice Age on the eponymously named Tarpan . It was reprinted in Fifth Edition with the same type. During the Grand Creature Type Update , the type was made obsolete and given errata to just be a Horse.

The Tarpan was last seen to have lived during the Ice Age of Dominaria . They appear as slightly more furry brown horses, making them more adapted to colder climates. General Jarkeld was said to state that a good Tarpan will serve its rider, faithful and true, while a bad one will kick them in the head. It is not known if they survived the Thaw .
